title: Keras Project Solutions - Dealing with Missing Data - Part Two

cues.en: (light ambient music) Instructor: Welcome back everyone.

cues.en: Remember, our options are to either keep the missing data drop the missing data, or fill in the missing data.
cues.zh: 請記得，我們可以保留、刪除或填補缺失資料。

cues.en: Let's review what data is missing and how we can work with it.

cues.en: Alright, so to begin section two on data pre-processing.

cues.en: We have a couple of goals and right now we're gonna focus on either removing or filling in any missing data.
cues.zh: 我們有幾個目標，目前先著重刪除或填補缺失資料。

cues.zh: 第一個儲存格其實不是任務，只是目前資料框的前幾列。

cues.zh: 接著建立 Series，顯示各欄缺失值的總數。

cues.zh: 之前示範過，呼叫 df.isnull，還記得它會傳回這樣的資料框。

cues.zh: 再跨列加總，得到各欄和其缺失資料點數。

cues.zh: emp_length 也缺了不少。

cues.en: Then we have this titles missing just a few missing on this particular feature.

cues.en: We're missing quite a bit on mort acc so we'll have to see what that is.

cues.en: And then we're also missing a couple on any public record of bankruptcies.
cues.zh: 公開破產紀錄也缺了幾筆。

cues.en: Okay, so what'll be interesting is to get these numbers in terms of percentage of this total data frame just to see how significant
cues.zh: 接著如果能把這些數量轉成占整份資料框的百分比，就能知道問題，

cues.en: of a problem is it.
cues.zh: 有多嚴重。

cues.zh: 我想看到的是：職稱缺少 5.7%，房貸帳戶數缺少將近 10%。

cues.zh: 來看看怎麼做。

cues.en: One way to do it is to get our previous series recall that is DF.isnull().sum.
cues.zh: 其中一種方法是取得先前的 Series，也就是 df.isnull().sum()。

cues.en: And then if I simply divide every item there by the length of the data frame I can then multiply that by 100 to get a percentage and that is how we can get this exact same result.
cues.zh: 每一項除以資料框長度，再乘 100，就能得到百分比，也就是這個結果。

cues.en: So it should be fine to drop some of these.

cues.zh: 也可以進一步示範，對 emp_length 的比率結果，

cues.en: By saying plot kind is equal to bar, run that and I can see the percentages or the ratios, essentially the same information.
cues.zh: 呼叫 plot(kind='bar')，查看百分比或比值，基本上是相同資訊。

cues.en: Really what I'm looking for here is the fact that since all these bars are almost the same height there really isn't that much information or differentiation between the employment length columns
cues.zh: 我真正關注的是，所有長條幾乎一樣高，表示不同工作年資沒有太多資訊或區別，

cues.en: which is kind of surprising.
cues.zh: 這有點令人意外。

cues.en: But we can see here the main difference is that people who work for 10 years have a slightly smaller charge off rate than people who worked less
cues.zh: 但可以看到主要差異是，工作十年的人，呆帳率比工作較短的人稍低，

cues.en: like one year or less than a year.
cues.zh: 例如一年或不到一年。

cues.en: But the difference is not extreme enough to really validate keeping this feature.
cues.zh: 不過差異不夠大，不足以支持保留這個特徵。

cues.en: So since they're so extremely similar across all employments, what we'll go ahead and do is just drop that column.
cues.zh: 因為所有工作年資都非常相似，就直接刪除這一欄。

cues.en: We'll say DF is equal to df.drop employment length, axis is equal to one.
cues.zh: 使用 df = df.drop，刪除 emp_length，axis=1。

cues.en: So run that and next revisit the data frame to see what feature columns still have missing data.
cues.zh: 執行後，再查看資料框中哪些特徵欄仍有缺失資料。

cues.en: So say df.isnull().sum, go ahead and run that.
cues.zh: 使用 df.isnull().sum()，執行。

cues.en: You'll get back this series and it looks like we still have the title.
cues.zh: 得到這個 Series，看起來還有 title，

cues.en: This revol_util, this mortgage accounts and the Public Record Bankruptcies.
cues.zh: revol_util、mort_acc，以及 pub_rec_bankruptcies。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and continue dealing with these remaining missing features in the continuation of this lecture.
cues.zh: 接下來會繼續處理這些仍有缺失值的特徵。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
